limitations: Single local worked step; not the four-client M0 aggregation fixture or scalar fzknum implementation.
No independent numerical replication or formal theorem is asserted.

evaluation_semantics.trace_scope: The encoded training trace specifies rounded prediction/residual; it does not define an evaluation-loss metric.
evaluation_semantics.exact_decoded_model: Half-squared loss uses prediction=sum_j(W_j*X_j)/scale^2 and target=Y/scale, without rounding the prediction.
evaluation_semantics.rounded_encoded_prediction: A loss defined from Q/scale instead uses the declared rounded Q. It is a different metric and must be labeled separately.
evaluation_semantics.validation_status: Formula distinction specified; no independent numerical evidence is adopted by this clarification.
